title: The revenge-trading spiral that cost him $600,000
caption: Tradever's CEO on his worst trading mistake, and the rule he follows now. #tradever #propfirm #tradingtips #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: He lost over *$600,000* in about *two weeks*.
My worst trading mistake was probably whenever I would go into episodes of revenge trading.
I was up $150,000 and I didn't take profit and within a minute the market flipped back.
Once you lose like two or three losses in a row, you got to just stop.
slides.sub: His rule now. There's always another day to trade.
